description: Knowledge about Earth, locations, environments, populations, and physical features.

topics.name: Earth Fundamentals
knowledge: Geography studies Earth’s places, environments, and relationships between humans and the planet.
Earth contains continents, oceans, mountains, rivers, and different climates.
Maps and geographic data help understand locations and environments.

topics.name: Physical Geography
knowledge: Physical geography studies natural features of Earth.
Mountains, deserts, forests, rivers, and oceans shape the planet.
Climate and weather influence ecosystems and human activities.

topics.name: Human Geography
knowledge: Human geography studies populations, cultures, cities, and societies.
Cities develop based on resources, transportation, and human needs.
Population patterns change through migration and development.

topics.name: Countries and Regions
knowledge: Countries are organized territories with governments and populations.
Regions can be studied by geography, culture, economy, and history.
International connections influence trade, technology, and cooperation.

topics.name: Environmental Knowledge
knowledge: The environment includes living organisms and the physical world around them.
Environmental science studies ecosystems and human impact on Earth.
Sustainable practices help protect natural resources.
